Seaside Volley.name: Malibu Beach Volleyball
Seaside Volley.summary: Welcome to Malibu: Volleyball capital of the world. This is where the best come to play--and show off their tans. If you want in, sign up. But keep your eyes on the ball...there'll be plenty of time for bikini-watching after the match!

WordZap.name: WordZap
WordZap.summary: A Game Boy port of the PC title WordZap. In the Game Boy version, players can choose between 3-, 4-, or 5-letter words. They can also enable or disable hints, allow or disallow plural forms of words and even choose the level of vocabulary used in the game.
